title: Circular Connectors for Radio and Associated Sound Equipment for Frequencies Below 3 MHz Including DC, Part 8: Free Seven Pin Connector for Microphone with Remote Control, Type 11777 IS-07
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 11777 (PART 8)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Circular Connectors for Radio and Associated Sound Equipment for Frequencies Below 3 MHz Including DC, Part 8: Free Seven Pin Connector for Microphone with Remote Control, Type 11777 IS-07.
clause_3_terminology: Circular Connectors for Radio and Associated Sound Equipment for Frequencies Below 3 MHz Including DC
Part 8: Free Seven Pin Connector for Microphone with Remote Control

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
